messages:
deploy-bot: PROD gate requires manual approval before rolling to remaining prod clusters.
Environment: prod-west-1, prod-east-2.
Tag: `v2.18.0-hotfix` (commit `a1b2c3d4`).
Canary: 3/3 canaries healthy (latency P95=48ms, error rate=0.02%).
Change window: 02:00-03:00 UTC.
Release notes (brief): fix N+1 in tokenizer caching, small safety fallback for model timeouts. No DB migrations.
Rollback plan: branch `rollback/180123` pin -> previous tag `v2.17.9`.
Action: request manual prod approval to continue with rolling deploy.

Maria G.: quick q — does this change the quantization profile or model shard layout? I want to avoid cold-start token spikes.

Sam K.: can confirm model binary same as canary earlier today, only config tweak to cache TTL. ran perf test at 1k rps: steady.

Jin P.: SRE check — error budget impact looks fine. snippets: `5m_error_rate=0.02%, p95=48ms`. No alerts firing.

Ops Oncall: FYI we have a scheduled infra job at 02:45 UTC that touches the db replicas. recommend we avoid full cluster rolling during that 5m window.

Lee T.: can someone delay final roll until after 02:50? small risk if jobs overlap.

Alex R.: prefer we proceed — this is a hotfix blocking customer flows. If Ops can confirm the infra job is non-blocking we can patch around it.

Maria G.: approving now — I reviewed canary logs and cache metrics. :white_check_mark: (approve by Maria G.)

deploy-bot: Approval recorded: Maria G. — proceeding with rolling deploy to prod-west-1 remaining hosts in 30s.

Jin P.: leaving a short rollback checklist in the runbook: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-server --to-revision=2`, and DNS pin if needed.

Ops Oncall: confirmed infra job is read-only maintenance, safe to proceed after 02:50. Recommend staggered batches 10% increments.

Lee T.: noted, will monitor.

deploy-bot: Rolling deploy started (step 1/10).

deploy-bot: Rolling deploy complete for prod-west-1. No regressions observed in first 10m.

Alex R.: thanks team. will follow up in release notes with post-mortem if anything odd shows up.

deploy-bot: Deployment finished. Tag `v2.18.0-hotfix` fully live in prod-west-1; pending prod-east-2 scheduling.
